meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 15 — Continued dig. Indigenous population statistics and geography, foreign-resident distribution by locality, water-resources and industrial-water statistics (critical semiconductor constraint), and additional cross-links that further densify social, spatial and resource edges.
meta.strategy_note: Keeps digging into under-represented but high-value domains that intersect the hub, demographic, semiconductor and spatial clusters already built.

candidates.title: Indigenous peoples population statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of the Interior / Council of Indigenous Peoples
candidates.description: Official statistics on the registered Indigenous population (recently ~629,000 / 2.7 % of total), by recognised tribe (Amis, Paiwan, Atayal and others), age structure (younger median age than the national average) and dependency ratios.
candidates.notes: Distinct demographic component with different age structure from the super-aged national average. Adds social and identity depth to the demographic cluster.

candidates.title: Indigenous population by county / city (Hualien, Taoyuan, Taitung concentrations)
candidates.region: Multiple (especially eastern counties and selected metros)
candidates.description: Geographic distribution of the Indigenous population. Highest absolute numbers in Hualien County, Taoyuan City and Taitung County — linking eastern peripheral counties and certain urban areas to the Indigenous demographic node.
referenced_by: Taoyuan and other municipal demographic profiles
candidates.notes: Spatial edge that connects the Indigenous demographic series to the sub-national geography already mapped.

candidates.title: Plains Indigenous (Pingpu) status recognition and registration framework
candidates.publisher: Council of Indigenous Peoples / Ministry of the Interior
candidates.description: Legal and administrative framework (including the recent Plains Indigenous Peoples Status Act) for recognition and registration of Plains Indigenous groups. Ongoing applications and status determination create a living policy and statistical process.
candidates.notes: Legal-status node that expands the Indigenous cluster beyond the 16 officially recognised tribes.

candidates.title: Foreign residents by region / nationality statistics
candidates.publisher: National Immigration Agency / Ministry of the Interior
candidates.description: Official counts of foreign residents broken down by nationality and by county / city. Complements the earlier foreign-worker node with a full resident-stock and geographic distribution view.
candidates.notes: Geographic densification of the migration cluster. Links foreign presence to the same spatial hierarchy as the Indigenous and general population series.

candidates.title: Water resources and water-use statistics (domestic, industrial, agricultural)
candidates.publisher: Water Resources Agency, Ministry of Economic Affairs
candidates.description: Annual and regional statistics on water use by sector (domestic, industrial, agricultural), supply sources (surface, ground, reservoirs, alternative), and regional balances. Industrial water demand is a recognised constraint for semiconductor expansion.
candidates.notes: Critical resource node. Directly intersects the semiconductor ‘five shortages’ (water, power, labour, land, talent) and the resilience cluster.

candidates.title: Industrial water demand and semiconductor-related water constraint indicators
candidates.publisher: Water Resources Agency / Ministry of Economic Affairs / industry commentary cited in official contexts
candidates.description: Statistical and policy indicators of industrial water use with explicit attention to the semiconductor and science-park load. Recurrent official and industry concern about water availability (especially in drier southern and central areas) forms a binding constraint on capacity expansion.
candidates.notes: Resource-edge densification of the semiconductor cluster. Makes the physical constraint statistically visible.

candidates.title: Reservoir storage, drought and water-rationing statistics
candidates.publisher: Water Resources Agency / Central Weather Administration related
candidates.description: Operational statistics on reservoir levels, drought declarations and historical water-rationing episodes (including the severe 2021 drought). Provide the high-frequency risk layer behind the industrial-water constraint.
candidates.notes: Risk and event node that links climate variability to industrial and social resilience.

candidates.title: Semiconductor ‘five shortages’ framing (water, power, labour, land, talent)
candidates.publisher: Industry and government sources (recurrent in official speeches and policy documents)
candidates.description: Recurring policy and industry framing of the five binding constraints on semiconductor expansion: water, electric power, labour, land and high-end talent. Functions as a conceptual but heavily cited organising node that pulls together previously separate resource, labour and land series.
referenced_by: Water, energy, talent, labour-shortage and science-park land statistics
Industrial Innovation Act and capacity-expansion planning
candidates.notes: High-citation organising node. Explicitly densifies edges among the resource, labour and industrial clusters.

candidates.title: Industrial and science-park land-use / land-availability statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / National Science and Technology Council / local governments
candidates.description: Statistics and planning indicators on land allocated to science parks, industrial zones and related high-tech uses. Land scarcity is one of the recognised ‘five shortages’ constraining further semiconductor clustering.
candidates.notes: Land-side densification of the spatial and semiconductor clusters.

candidates.title: Taiwan continued-dig densification meta-node (indigenous, foreign-resident geography, water/resource constraints)
candidates.publisher: Derived from MOI, CIP, Immigration Agency, Water Resources Agency and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node recording the further densification of social (Indigenous population and geography, foreign-resident distribution) and resource (water, drought, industrial-water, land, five-shortages) layers and their edges into the demographic, spatial, semiconductor and resilience clusters.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier demographic, sub-national, semiconductor and resilience meta-nodes
candidates.notes: Book-keeping node for the continued dig.
